newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Kewaunee nuke startup delayed.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Kewaunee nuke startup delayed.

text.p: Wisconsin Public Service Corp has delayed the startup of its 503 megawatt Kewaunee nuclear power plant to late December from a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage, a company spokesman said.
The Carlton, Wis. unit was shut September 20 for the outage, and had originally been expected to resume service near the beginning of November.
"We have some extra work we want to do on the steam generator tubes," spokesman Clark Steinhardt said Friday, adding "it should come back in the last half of December."
The Kewaunee plant is operated and 41.2 percent owned by Wisconsin Public, a subsidiary of WPS Resources Corp.
WPL Holdings Inc subsidiary Wisconsin Power and Light Co holds a 41 percent interest in the plant, while Madison Gas & Electric Co holds the remaining 17.8 percent.
